_about: Public-domain Hugh Stowell Brown (1823-1886), Baptist minister of Myrtle Street Chapel, Liverpool, popular lecturer to working men, for the Word Hoard: The Pilgrim Fathers (1854), Lectures for the People (1859-60), Lectures to Working Men (1870) and Manliness and Other Sermons (1889). Hugh Stowell, his uncle, has his own shelf. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 66 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hsbrown-pilgrim-fathers: The Pilgrim fathers (Manchester, T. Agnew and Sons, 1854)
hsbrown-lectures-for-people: Lectures for the people (Philadelphia, G. G. Evans, 1860)

_excluded.hsbrown-other: His uncle Hugh Stowell's works (hugh-stowell shelf); memoirs of him by others
